design.api: new file brute/api/certify16.py (additive; certify14.py and every frozen file untouched): Certifier16(initial, num_actions, family_bound<=16, search='a16') with current(), observe(action, reading), propose() (the next experiment word chosen by the A16 policy) and close(); certify16(initial, actions, observations, ...) one-shot form; returns {'api': 'brute.certify/16', 'label': ID|IDF|AMB|IDU, 'model', 'n_min', 'family_bound', 'calls', 'unknown'}; search values 'region','s2','s3','s4' delegate to certify/14 unchanged.
